title: Chapter 736 - 736 Decided; As Worthy Of You!
content:
Chapter 736 - 736 Decided; As Worthy Of You!

Chapter 736 - 736 Decided; As Worthy of You!

736 Decided; As Worthy of You!

According to everyone’s speculation, Star Lord 5901 was very likely to be closely related to the person who killed Zach and destroyed the 10 golden warships.

In fact, it might even be him!

It was no wonder that everyone was so concerned about it.

Qin Xian’s back felt a little heavy after being stared at by so many important figures.

After a while, he said with much difficulty,” That planet is called Earth, and its owner is called Lin Fan.”

Earth?

Lin Fan?

Everyone silently memorized these two names in their hearts.

Qin Xian continued,” Lin Fan is extremely handsome. According to the core disciples of Dragon Tiger Sect, Fenghua Sect, True Martial Sect, and the others, Lin Fan is extremely strong and bottomless! Defeating these core disciples was just a single move.”

“Thus, I went to invite him to participate in the universe contest and explained the benefits.”

“But Lin Fan didn’t seem to mind at all and rejected him directly.”

Hearing this, everyone began to analyze quickly in their hearts.

The Longhu Sect, Fenghua Sect, and True Martial Sect were all sects that were slightly famous. Lin Fan’s strength was not simple to defeat these core disciples in one move.

And the universe competition was a grand event that happened once every million years.

Especially this time, with the attention of the Sacred Lord, it was even more important.

In the end, the other party rejected him without hesitation?

This explained many things.

Perhaps the other party had many opportunities and didn’t care about the rewards of the universe competition.

In fact, there was already a Sacred Lord behind him!

When everyone thought of this, their impression of Earth and Lin Fan’s rankings deepened and became even more serious.

At this moment, the Great Elder said,” No matter what, Lin Fan is helping us to defend against the Ocean Universe. The stronger he is, the greater our chances.”

After pausing for a moment, he continued,” One year from now, the Ocean Universe Master will come to 5901 personally. I plan to lead the army to help Lin Fan. Is anyone willing to go with me?””

When everyone heard this, they were all stunned.

However, they soon revealed a look of realization.

But now, Lin Fan was so domineering.

It was very likely that there was a Sacred Lord standing behind him.

If he were to form a relationship with Lin Fan and the Sacred Master behind him because of this…

Then, the crisis of the Four Seasons Universe would be resolved.

Taking a step back, even if Lin Fan didn’t have a Sacred Master behind him…

However, Lin Fan had the power to kill Zach and destroy 10 golden battleships. He was worth recruiting.

In fact, if Lin Fan could hold off the Ocean Universe Master, the Four Seasons Universe could even use this chance to crush the Ocean Universe’s attack in one fell swoop.

In a sense, this was definitely an opportunity.

Thinking of this, the Lord of Spring was the first to say,””I’m the master of the Spring Region. It’s my duty to protect the Spring Region!”

Then, everyone chimed in.

“I’m willing to go with you!”

“Me too!”

“I’ll go too!”

“I’m willing to go!”

….

Many voices echoed in the palace.

It looked like it was going to have a life and death battle with the ocean universe.

….

Dragon Tiger Sect.

Ever since the Spring Field was attacked by the ocean universe, the once powerful Dragon Tiger Sect had become very miserable.

“Where is the ocean universe army?”

“It stopped! The ocean universe army stopped advancing!”

“Really?”

“That’s great!”

The heated discussions rose and fell.

Many people went to check on the situation.

When they received confirmation, everyone was delighted.

“What is going on?”

“Yeah, why did the ocean universe stop?”

” Quickly look at the cosmic news!”

” Something big has happened in the universe news!”

Everyone took out their communicators.

“The ocean universe issued a declaration against 5901?”

“5901 killed Zach? Destroyed 10 golden warships?”

“This is definitely the counterattack of our Four Seasons Universe!”

“That’s great!”

….

Qin Qiuliang, who was in the crowd, picked up his communicator.

In the next moment, his pupils constricted.

Because he saw planet 5901 on the news. It was Earth.

In that case, the person who killed Zach and destroyed the Golden Battleship could very well be Lin Fan!

Qin Qiuliang praised,”As expected of you!””

….

Earth.

Lin Fan was completely oblivious to all of this.

After merging and linking up his cultivation techniques, he cursed Sacred Lord Tyrannical out of boredom.

Then, he looked at his character relationships and found that all the familiar people were in their normal states. He felt a little relieved.

Then, Lin Fan placed his attention on Ma Zheng and used his soul to communicate with him.

“Ma Zheng!”

….

In a spacious meeting hall.

Originally, Ma Zheng was discussing something with a group of people.

When he heard this voice, his expression suddenly turned solemn.

Then, he said to everyone,”You guys can leave first.””

Everyone was slightly stunned.

Didn’t he want to make a decision as soon as possible?

Why was he asking him to retreat now?

Ma Zheng saw that everyone was still in a daze and could not help but shout,”Hurry up and retreat!”

“Yes, sir!” The crowd no longer dared to hesitate and left.

After the door closed, Ma Zheng hurriedly knelt on the ground and said respectfully,”Greetings, Master!”

Even though Lin Fan wasn’t there.

However, Ma Zheng did not dare to neglect his etiquette.

“Master, I’m sorry to have kept you waiting. I was in the middle of a meeting with the upper echelons of the Raincloud Sanctum.”Ma Zheng said.

Lin Fan said,” It’s fine. What’s your status in the Raincloud Sanctum now?””

“I’m now the vice altar master of Raincloud Sanctum.” Ma Zheng said.

“That’s right!” Lin Fan said.

These words could be said to be Lin Fan’s heartfelt words.

One had to know…

Not long ago, Ma Zheng was just an ordinary elder.

In fact, he had only joined the Raincloud Altar for less than a hundred years.

This speed of advancement was truly astonishing.

“All of this is thanks to Master’s nurturing!” Ma Zheng said respectfully.”

These words were also Ma Zheng’s heartfelt words.

He believed that he was capable.

However, in this world, the strong were always respected.

Without enough power, no matter how strong one’s ability was, it would be useless.

And Lin Fan had given him such power.

” Master,” Ma Zheng said,” I heard that the Master of the Ocean Universe has issued a declaration of war against Earth. He’s preparing to personally lead his army to launch an attack in a year’s time. Is there anything I can help you with?””

Lin Fan raised his brows. The Ocean Master was personally leading the army?

This formation was definitely not small.

However, Lin Fan’s tone was still very calm as he said,””You don’t have to worry about this matter. “The only thing you have to do now is to continue to become stronger and obtain greater power.”

Through this matter, Lin Fan felt that having power was an extremely important thing.

If he had a powerful enough force, the Ocean Lord would have turned into ashes without him knowing as soon as he issued such a declaration.

“I’ll teach you a cultivation technique now. Cultivate well.”Lin Fan said.

“Thank you, Master.” Ma Zheng said excitedly.
